title: Another view leaves hope for difference
meaning: Combining different actions through willingness to suspend a familiar perspective is emotionally expressed in hope for a possible shared continuation.
text: Difference can become visible as a possibility when a familiar perspective changes. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions where you combine different needs and ways of participating. The Hanged Man in energy motivates suspending a habitual approach and allowing another view. The Star in emotions adds hope, openness and inspiration. The overall tone can therefore be unhurried and prospective: you practically combine different approaches for another perspective and emotionally see room for a shared undertaking without needing its final form already defined.

For example, you combine one person’s drawings with the other’s short notes after setting aside the judgement that the work must be a finished album. Another view allows some pages to remain open for future impressions. The unusual combination brings encouragement. **Our different ways of expression may still become a shared continuation.** Hope concerns an emerging possibility; it guarantees neither that every later fragment will fit easily nor that both people will want the same scale. An open form can hold that uncertainty.

A difficulty arises if inspiration is hurried into an obligation. One person is still trying another perspective while the other already expects a full shared project and regular work. The open prospect becomes rigid, and difference feels obstructive again. The Star promises no result, and the Hanged Man requires no endless wait for an ideal view. Temperance in action allows contributions to change while leaving room to recognise different wishes about continuing.
